notify.beyondsolo.break.unstable.title: Unstable Gate
notify.beyondsolo.break.unstable.body: The %s-Rank gate %s blocks to the %s is coming apart. It will break in about %s minutes unless someone clears it.
notify.beyondsolo.break.imminent.title: Dungeon Break Imminent
notify.beyondsolo.break.imminent.body: The %s-Rank gate %s blocks to the %s will break in %s seconds. Its monsters are about to pour out.
quest.beyondsolo.dungeon_break.desc: The %s-Rank gate nearby has broken and its monsters are pouring out. Hold them back and defeat %s to close it.
message.beyondsolo.gate.broken: This gate has broken. Its monsters are out here now: defeat its boss to close it.
